name: Remnants of War

angles.text: As an Undead, you know Naxxramas threatened the Undercity itself. Recovering the fragments helps protect your people from Scourge power on their doorstep.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Tirisfal Glades from lingering Scourge magic. You protect the Undercity and the Horde's foothold in northern Lordaeron.
As a Mage, handle Naxxramas's broken necrotic crystals with care. Unstable magical energy remains within them.
As a Priest, you face the unholy corruption lingering in the shards. It threatens to defile the land further.

faq.answer: The necrotic crystal fragments are pieces of the great focusing crystal once mounted atop Naxxramas. The crystal was destroyed during the assault on the Undercity, and shards fell across Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: What are the necrotic crystal fragments?

faq.answer: Naxxramas came to Tirisfal Glades to destroy the Undercity and wipe out the Forsaken. The Forsaken and the Argent Dawn fought it off, though both suffered heavy losses.
faq.q: Why did Naxxramas attack the Undercity?

aliases: why do cultists want the crystals
what do cultists want with shards
faq.answer: Scourge cultists search Tirisfal Glades for the shattered fragments because necrotic magic remains within them. They hope to reclaim that power for the Scourge.
faq.q: Why are Scourge cultists collecting the crystal fragments?

aliases: are the crystals dangerous to touch
faq.answer: Yes. Though broken and largely drained of their original charge, the fragments still hold volatile necrotic energy. Direct contact is dangerous.
faq.q: Is handling the necrotic crystals dangerous?

faq.answer: The Forsaken fought beside the Argent Dawn to defend the Undercity from Naxxramas. Both suffered heavy losses in the battle.
faq.q: Who helped the Forsaken fight off Naxxramas?

aliases: will tirisfal be clean of crystals
can they clear all the fragments
faq.answer: Clearing every crystal fragment from Tirisfal will take years. The crystal shattered above the glades and scattered shards far and wide. Residents will keep finding them in the soil.
faq.q: Will all the necrotic crystals ever be cleared from Tirisfal?

sections.body: Naxxramas once loomed over Tirisfal Glades, seeking to wipe out the Undercity and the Forsaken. The Forsaken and the Argent Dawn fought off the floating fortress in a desperate defense. Both sides suffered heavy losses. During the battle, the immense necrotic focusing crystal atop Naxxramas was destroyed, scattering fragments across the glades.
sections.title: The Shadow Over the City

sections.body: Naxxramas was driven away, but pieces of its crystal remain in the soil. Scourge cultists search for the fragments, hoping to use the dark magic still within them. Gathering the shards keeps that power from the Scourge. Yet clearing every fragment from Tirisfal will take years.
sections.title: Scattered Necromancy

summary: Across Tirisfal Glades, remnants of war lie scattered beneath the soil. Naxxramas was driven from the Undercity at great cost to the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn. Its shattered necrotic focusing crystal remains a danger, and Scourge cultists seek its fragments for the dark magic within.
attribution: In-game quest text: Remnants of War
